name: Min-arc stop knuckle 4R: a preloaded one-sided knuckle in link 1 with J2 hard stops (plain spherical chain)

mechanism.notes: spherical 3R with link 1 split by a passive knuckle K. bodies: link 1a, link 1b, link 2, member 3 (hub-3 arm-end plate + K7 neck). joints: J1, K, J2, J3 O20 hubs on MR117-2RS pairs (revolutes). Open chain, GH closes it: loop mobility 4 vs the arm's 3 - the spare is set by the clock spring in K's cap (preload onto stop A) and the J2 interior-angle hard stops (min-arc law), so nothing sags (R17). sensed: K (encoder, the 4th coordinate is not a function of J1-J3 readings alone). custom: base, 3 links, member 3, 4 hub shafts, the clock spring strip (0.2 x 3 mm stainless, ~4 turns); catalogue: 4 x MR117-2RS pair + 2 O2 ISO 8734 stop dowels (K stop arc slot, J2 stop arc slot).

verdict: in progress: variant B (pin knee + knuckle) 18.46 fast vs the pin knee 23.64 at the same seats; variant A (plain chain) best coarse 49.10; CMA streams of both + frozen exact wear running on the farm
limiter: variant A: in-band (0.62; link 2 0.27, hub 2 0.55) - the plain spherical chain with O20 hubs in the kit; the knuckle adds 3.9 points over its own 3R control. Variant B: follow 0.917 (knee slide window, 8-12 clip frames) and contact 0.07 (forced poses: 5 of 15 forced ws poses penetrate)
note: Bench(60,160) fast. Variant A (docs/concepts/models/minarc-stop-knuckle-4r.py, kit): seeds 66.93, 3R control 62.57; coarse LHS 302 configs best 49.10 (3R control at the same seats 52.98). Variant B (docs/concepts/models/minarc-stop-knuckle-4r-pinknee.py, the pin-knee VModel + K): at the pin knee's best seats (row best_params) with bk1 30 / bk2 50: knuckle locked 22.57, phi 15/170 a1max 70: 19.12, a1max 75: 18.46 (reach 0.819, ib14 0.912, follow 0.917, contact 0.070), margin-equivalent stops phi 22/148 (J2 never within 5 deg of its fold): 20.31; the plain pin-knee model at the same params 23.64.
